title: Invocation concordance monitor and auto-revert for function-call shape drift
creator: Samir Patel
description: Build an invocation concordance monitoring service paired with an automatic rollback orchestrator to detect function-call / structured-output shape drift during canary and A/B rollouts. This ticket covers normalization, fuzzy/shallow diffs, semantic argument equivalence checks, traffic gating, and playbook integration for automated unwind when a new model variant shows regressions in call shape or required fields. Goal: stop customer-facing contract regressions fast while minimizing false positives during stochastic generation.
acceptance_criteria: Concordance scorer deployed as a sidecar pipeline for shadow and canary traffic; per-request score emitted to telemetry
Configurable delta thresholds per-function and per-field that can be changed from Console without a code deploy
Auto-revert policy triggers a staged rollback (canary -> 0%) when concordance falls below threshold for 5m and error rate for tool-invocations increases >2x
False-positive rate < 1% on heldout synthetic perturbation suite
Integration tests cover nested object field reorderings, optional arg omission, and type-coercion cases
Console dashboard displays concordance histogram, example diffs, and recent auto-reverts with links to PRs and runbooks
tasks: Design normalization rules and canonical serializer for function call payloads (Samir)
Add deterministic shadow-sink wiring for canary runs (Platform infra)
Create canary gating policy & auto-revert orchestrator (Infra + Runtime)
Write e2e test harness and synthetic perturbation suite (QA)
Console: add ribbon & alerting sections for concordance signals (DX)
Run 48h smoke on internal beta with traffic slice and collect baseline
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy concordance scorer as shadow-only for 2 days (0% production impact) and collect baseline. 2) Enable scoring in canary routing for 5% traffic and start gating (non-blocking) for 12h. 3) Flip gating to blocking for incremental canary buckets with auto-revert policy in test-mode (notify-only) for 6h. 4) Enable full auto-revert after 48h of stable false-positive rate metrics. 5) Gradually roll to 25%/50%/100% following successful checks.
test_plan: Use synthetic prompt corpus that covers: nominal tool calls, optional arg omission, extra unexpected fields, canonical vs aliased arg names, nested list reordering, and semantically-equivalent numeric/string coercions. Run adversarial fuzzing for N=5000 examples and validate concordance score distribution. Add integration tests that simulate canary traffic plus induced backward-incompatible model variant. CI will fail if FP > 1% on the heldout suite.
